name: From Gigs to Giants
description: Idle Clicker Business Tycoon game that combines neat and clean design with clever and hooking mini games that has a bigger purpose. Also the focus shifts drasticallly during the way. The first change is to change from manual labour for someone else's business to own your own and at the first time feel the pressure that comes from hiring people into a company you bought with bank loan that is tied with your family's home.
